name: desklib
description: Desk’lib : outil interne de réservation de bureaux (flex office), projet portfolio

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @desklib/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @desklib/api" "npm run start -w @desklib/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @desklib/shared && npm run build -w @desklib/api && npm run build -w @desklib/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @desklib/shared && npm run test -w @desklib/api && npm run test -w @desklib/web
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run e2e
scripts.screenshots: cross-env SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/screenshots.spec.ts
